section.p: My name is Francisco but you can call me Fran! As a Software Engineer, I’ve been 'introducing' bugs since 2011!
AI / GenAI engineering: LLM APIs (Gemini/Vertex), enterprise RAG & retrieval, evaluation & grounding, agentic workflows & MCP, GCP deployment, guardrails.

Software engineer with broad, strong engineering experience across frontend and architecture, now moving into applied AI and AI engineering. I work hands-on with coding agents, from early Antigravity experiments to continuous, parallel multi-agent development: coordinated agents with persistent project memory and automated validation across repositories.
